note: A node-scope export's `devupJson` now reads the variables that the screen's variables alias, and what those alias in turn, even when no node in the screen binds them. Only the bound ones were read, so a local variable aliasing a library primitive - `containerX` on the devup Test file's Mobile and Desktop frames - was reported unresolved and left out of the theme. The whole-file theme already read them. Both the direct path and the Devup Bridge run the same scripts, so the plugin bundle is rebuilt.
